notes: litert-community/Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B: nemotron3_nano_30b_a3b_int4_ekv2048.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16 at revision bf77c317 (NVIDIA Nemotron Open Model License), a 52-layer hybrid decoder (23 Mamba-2 layers, 23 mixture-of-experts layers with 128 routed experts of which 6 are used for each token plus one shared expert, 6 attention layers; 30B parameters, 3.5B active) that thinks before it answers by default; written with the LiteRT Tensor API one tensor at a time: each layer's routed experts in one `moe` custom op, relu² written as the op's gelu_tanh with the input scaled by 256 and each expert's output by 1/65,536, and an exact `moe * 0` second consumer so the GPU delegate does not fuse the next op into the expert kernel; routed experts int4 blockwise (block 128 in the up projection and 64 in the down projection, whose input is 1,856 wide; fp32 scales raised to at least 2^-14; ai-edge-quantizer 0.10.1's min-max rules) in the moe op; Mamba-2 in / out projections, attention q / k / v / o and shared experts int4 blockwise (block 32, the same rules and floor); token table and lm_head int8 per channel; router, norms and the Mamba-2 convolution, A, D and dt bias fp32; fp32 activations declared; KV cache 2,048; the checkpoint's tokenizer.json byte for byte. The repository holds four files (int4 and mixed_int4, each with a 2,048- and a 4,096-token cache); each has its own model id. Mac Studio rows only; no phone was tried. This file name first held other bytes (sha256 f1bea1c5..., experts in blocks of 32, commit a69ffd02 of 2026-11-10T19:46:59.000Z); these bytes replaced them at 5792549c. This document holds the file's benchmark cells and line-3 records of 2026-11-12. Landed 2026-11-12 after the close-out: litert-community/Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B is public and ungated (license other: nvidia-nemotron-open-model-license; base_model nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B-BF16, quantized; library_name litert-lm), main 5792549c3a (2026-11-12T12:56:32.000Z) at the read; these bytes reached the Hub at commit 5792549c3a (2026-11-12T12:56:32.000Z); the tree's LFS oid and size of nemotron3_nano_30b_a3b_int4_ekv2048.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 17844203904 B (anonymous, read 2026-11-12 22:45:54 JST).
